reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Not so good, not so bad, decent academics with poor campus life.

review_content.Placements: The college is decent enough strict with academics, with a few less extra curricular activities. The placements for mechanical engineering. The highest package offered is 12 LPA and the average package is 5 to 6 LPA this year in 2025 even internships are offered if your academics and resume are strong.
review_content.Infrastructure: The library is good and huge with e library and Wi-Fi. The hostel campus is good and decent and all the facilities are available like a gym, basketball court, tennis court, volleyball court also sports and events happen frequently. The clubs are very active and creative.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Best college for engineering in Nashik.

review_content.Placements: Getting placement in Civil Engineering is really hard these days. But still, our college provides about 50% placement every year. The recruiting companies are good. Roles such as site supervisors, internships, or direct placements are offered to some students before graduation.
review_content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi service is really great and helpful. No matter which corner of the college one is in. They always get a good Wi-Fi connection. Labs are well-equipped. The library is useful and big. There used to be a canteen inside the campus, but now it is directly outside the college.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Information Technology Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Top-most colleges in Nashik. Worth studying, good infrastructure, and knowledge.

review_content.Placements: In Information Technology, about 80- 90 percent of students got placed from K. Wagh. Talking about the highest and the lowest packages, they are 20 LPA and 4 LPA, respectively. The average package goes around 6 LPA. The top recruiting companies for IT engineering are Druva, TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Bosch, HCL, Amazon, etc., offering jobs like Software Developer, Software Tester, Full-stack Developer, Trainee, Data Analyst, AI Engineer, etc. K. Wagh offers internship facilities with companies like Druva, Microsoft, KPIT, and Bosch. It varies from Rs. 10,000 per month.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: A balanced blend of academics, campus life, and growth opportunities.

review_content.Placements: 70% of students get placed in my college. The lowest package is 2.5 LPA, and the highest package offered is 12.5 LPA. The top recruiting companies are ABB, Mahindra, Hyosung, and Infotech. Nearly all the students get internships. All the stuff they teach is very interesting and skillful for us.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good. The classrooms are spacious, good, ventilated, and have a projector and Wi-Fi in every classroom. The hostels are adequately furnished with basic amenities such as clean rooms. 24/7 water supply and electricity backup.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: I'm satisfied with my college because it has good faculty, a good and big library, and more.

review_content.Placements: I don't know the exact percentage of students getting placed, but of 70 students, 40-55 students have been placed, and some have taken internships. The average package is 3 lakhs, and the highest is 18 lakhs, as far as I know. Companies like TCS, Winjit, Arees, etc., come to our campus. The roles offered include software engineer, software developer, data analyst, data scientist, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: I don't live in the hostel, but my friends say that the mess is okay compared to other messes. We have proper Wi-Fi with good range in college, and our labs are also good. There is free space for sitting, all PCs are in good condition, and in the classrooms, all fans and sitting benches are also good.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: My honest review about my college.

review_content.Placements: Our college campus placements were not very good. The average package was 2 LPA offered by the company. In our college, required percentage of 60 was required that's why I am planning to get outside placement. This was overall good college. Approximately 70% of placements were placed every year. I am thinking of doing an MBA after UG.
review_content.Infrastructure: I did not opt for hostel. My friends were living in a rented room which was very good for us and my two friends were in a good location and behind a college, for managing time at all times. My room was very good for a small budget and the best place.

For a medical emergency, an ambulance is always there.

The hostel facilities are also good, with a hot water supply available. Wi-Fi facility is provided in the mess, hostel, gym, and canteen etc.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Human Centered Design - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied with the faculty and facilities of the college.

content.Placements: At our institute, 30–40% of the students gets placed in this course. Students were getting enough placements opportunities. The average package offered was between 3 and 5 LPA. Various educational and research enterprises visits college for placements. The top roles offered were research engineer, development engineer, design engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good-quality facilities and infrastructure for the students. Labs, library, canteen, Wi-Fi, hostel, sports, etc. facilities were available for the students. The college offers various modern facilities for the upliftment of the students knowledge. Students were also getting hostel facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Industrial Arts and Design Practices - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It was a rollercoaster ride.

content.Placements: Our college doesn't provide placements and pushes students to find their opportunity areas. Many students got amazing offers and fulfilling experience opportunities in big companies like Bosch to a lot of startups like Vaidyuthi. They go into different sectors of branding, coding, developing, making, and designing.
content.Infrastructure: We have a lot of labs, especially for product designers with different machinery and equipment to learn and experience different skill sets. They also have other kinds of labs for shooting, printing, modeling, etc. We also have Wi-Fi available throughout the campus to access and a library with relevant books for the courses. We have a lot of different kinds of canteens accessible to all spread throughout the campus in walking distance.

individual_reviews.course: M.A. in Experience Design - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Intriguing two years of design education.

content.Placements: Around 70% of us got places in large organisations and startups. For some placements usually happened smoothly and for the others they had to look out and pursue for months. The companies that visited during the graduation show were IMB, Microsoft and some local startups.
content.Infrastructure: I don't think Srishti had a good Wi-Fi infrastructure. Classes were decent. The whole building was shared with another institution. The college was spread out into 4 buildings across different areas in the vicinity. Sometimes we would have to jump from one area to another for some college administration work.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Industrial Arts and Design Practices - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Really good environment to study design in.

content.Placements: Even though the college doesn't have any placement drive, everyone gets placed. The faculty helps with the placements. The college also has a graduation exhibition wherein the industry people come and hire the graduating students. This is Srishti's way of doing a placement drive.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is spot on. Yelahanka is an amazing space. The whole environment is pretty cool. The college has functional workshops where one can go and explore materials and techniques and then some. The facilitators are also very approachable.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the faculty and facilities of the college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good-quality facilities and infrastructure for the students. Labs, library, canteen, Wi-Fi, hostel, sports, etc. facilities were available for the students. The college offers various modern facilities for the upliftment of the students knowledge. Students were also getting hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It was a rollercoaster ride.
reviews.review_text: We have a lot of labs, especially for product designers with different machinery and equipment to learn and experience different skill sets. They also have other kinds of labs for shooting, printing, modeling, etc. We also have Wi-Fi available throughout the campus to access and a library with relevant books for the courses. We have a lot of different kinds of canteens accessible to all spread throughout the campus in walking distance.

reviews.review_heading: Intriguing two years of design education.
reviews.review_text: I don't think Srishti had a good Wi-Fi infrastructure. Classes were decent. The whole building was shared with another institution. The college was spread out into 4 buildings across different areas in the vicinity. Sometimes we would have to jump from one area to another for some college administration work.

reviews.review_heading: All in all, a really good college with good faculty members and placements.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities were available in college. There was a problem with the heat in college. There was no AC, and it would get quite hot during summer. So, it was difficult for students to sit and work in the college, and that lead to less productive work.

reviews.review_heading: Really good environment to study design in.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is spot on. Yelahanka is an amazing space. The whole environment is pretty cool. The college has functional workshops where one can go and explore materials and techniques and then some. The facilitators are also very approachable.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Srishti Institute of Art, Design and Technology.
reviews.review_text: It doesn't have one single enclosed campus. It's spread across Yelahanka. We have about 5 campuses. Traveling from one campus to another for courses have been fun and exciting, it somehow helped us integrate into the local society well because we stepped out.

reviews.review_heading: You either love it or hate it.
reviews.review_text: There is no campus life. There is no hostel facility, but there are PGs which the college suggests. Since the college is not answerable to you, there are a lot of complaints and no action. The canteen food is average, and the PGs provide the mess food. Srishti has a small house like building, and most are shared with other institutions, it is located in the dirt. All in all, the campus is not as good as you wish.

reviews.review_heading: Overwhelmingly satisfying faculty with risky placements but can make sufficient to earn well.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is more of an apartment that has been converted to its best to be made for a creative thinking place. Infrastructure was never an issue unless I want to roam around without any reason to have fun on my college campus. Apart from that, we have a really good medical facility. We have a department called wellness team who mentors for all the mental and health issues you want to discuss with them.

reviews.review_heading: Worried for placements and job opportunities.
reviews.review_text:
The quality of classrooms is decent as each class has only 20-25 students, hence, the rooms are big enough and ventilated.
The food provided to us in the canteen is tasty and hygienic at the same time.
We don't have a hostel but we live in PGs which are very old and so we keep facing problems of leakage and broken walls.

reviews.review_heading: Really Awesome for a best student.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are available, it's really awesome, food quality is too good, there is a water problem only sometimes and we also faced ragging. Neat place to study and we can gain good qualities and behavior with personality development as an add on.

review_summary.college_name: GLS University Ahmedabad Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: A good college in a good location with a nice campus and faculty members.

content.Placements: Many companies visit the college for placements for the year 2025. Some students got placements at companies. The placement cell also works hard to make sure students get their preferred job role. I guess the highest package offered is 8 or 9 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The B.Tech classrooms are nice. Labs are also well-maintained. It provides a good space for sitting and reading in the library. GLS College doesn't have its own hostel, but they have tie-ups with the hostel. The Hive Hostel is nice, and I stay there only.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (B.B.A.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Life at GLS University where you can experience your life's best 3 years.

content.Placements: If we have 100 students, many students don't appear in placement because they want to pursue an MBA, and those who appeared in placement got the placement, but not everyone got a good placement. Our college has companies like Arvind, Tata Motors, Bajaj, Smyten, and many more companies, and some of these offer the best placements.
content.Infrastructure: In GLS, we have the best classroom, and they are building new infrastructure for the next batches. We have a fully air-conditioned classroom. We have a library where you can find many books. Our college has an open gym in which you can go and exercise, and the college has a total of 3 canteens, and the canteen food is the best.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued (July 2025) - Integrated Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: This college is good for attitude and fashion.

content.Placements: Some students get placed by the college, some are self-placed, and some are still not placed. A few companies recruit only one student each. One incident I want to share is that a student forgot to fill out the placement form, so the college did not allow him to attend any company interviews. In the second phase, the college warned him and agreed to let him sit for the placement interviews.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is very good, and the computer labs are also very good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned and smart. The library is small but good, and the sports room is very large. Weekly game events are organized by students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. IT (Dual Specialization)/ B.Sc. IT (Hons.)/ Integrated M.Sc. IT - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: This university achieve A+ grade.

content.Placements: 80% of students got placed in our course. The highest salary is 5 LPA, and the lowest Rs 10,000 per month package offered in our course. IBM, TCS, Accenture, etc., are top recruiting companies for our course. 95% of students got internships from our course in IT companies. Roles offered are data scientist, software engineer, and cloud architect.
content.Infrastructure: Available courses are BCA, MBA, BBA iMSC-IT, B.Tech, B.Com, MCA, LL.B. UG, PG, law, design, management commerce, business administration, and engineering. Our college has Wi-Fi, AC classroom, lab, library, and study tour. It has very good quality of hostel, food, bed, canteen, sports, and semester.

individual_reviews.course: BBA (Dual Specialization)/ BBA (Hons.)/ Integrated MBA - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The best college you find. Go for it. You won't find such a supportive faculty.

content.Placements: The university is pretty good. The package offered is very good. The lowest package they offered is from 6.5 LPA-7 LPA and the highest package is up to 12 LPA-14 LPA. The management team is very good and the subjects they have included in it are very much helpful for your future jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The hostels are very clean and good and have enough space. They provide the bus also for the pick and drop services to the students. The campus is big and neat. The food is above average. Overall, the service is nice and one can get the best service over there.

reviews.review_heading: A good college in a good location with a nice campus and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The B.Tech classrooms are nice. Labs are also well-maintained. It provides a good space for sitting and reading in the library. GLS College doesn't have its own hostel, but they have tie-ups with the hostel. The Hive Hostel is nice, and I stay there only.

reviews.review_heading: Life at GLS University where you can experience your life's best 3 years.
reviews.review_text: In GLS, we have the best classroom, and they are building new infrastructure for the next batches. We have a fully air-conditioned classroom. We have a library where you can find many books. Our college has an open gym in which you can go and exercise, and the college has a total of 3 canteens, and the canteen food is the best.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Faculty of Computer Applications and Information Technology, GLS UniversityReviewed on 2 Jul 2025)
reviews.review_heading: This college is good for attitude and fashion.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is very good, and the computer labs are also very good. Classrooms are fully air-conditioned and smart. The library is small but good, and the sports room is very large. Weekly game events are organized by students.

reviews.review_heading: This university achieve A+ grade.
reviews.review_text: Available courses are BCA, MBA, BBA iMSC-IT, B.Tech, B.Com, MCA, LL.B. UG, PG, law, design, management commerce, business administration, and engineering. Our college has Wi-Fi, AC classroom, lab, library, and study tour. It has very good quality of hostel, food, bed, canteen, sports, and semester.

reviews.review_heading: The best college you find. Go for it. You won't find such a supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are very clean and good and have enough space. They provide the bus also for the pick and drop services to the students. The campus is big and neat. The food is above average. Overall, the service is nice and one can get the best service over there.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Faculty of Commerce, GLS UniversityReviewed on 10 May 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Kind of dummy college. Best for students who are preparing for other professional courses.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are dirty, with broken benches and slogans written on tables, but they are equipped with AC, projectors, and other facilities. The washrooms are clean and well-maintained. There is no access to the lifts for students. The canteen is good, and the food is great, though there is a lack of parking facilities during exams.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Faculty of Commerce, GLS UniversityReviewed on 28 Apr 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, good placements in 2025, really good infrastructure and campus life, etc.
reviews.review_text: The overall facilities were satisfactory and supported both academic and extracurricular development. Some minor improvements were needed in the hostel Wi-Fi and the mess menu variety. They provide good sports facilities like a basketball court, a football ground, a cricket pitch, badminton court.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Faculty of Commerce, GLS UniversityReviewed on 26 Apr 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Good facilities and slightly expensive.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, all classrooms are fully occupied with air-conditioners, and projects, whiteboards, blackboards, mike, speakers, podium, and seating are also very good and comfortable. There is one problem, which is parking.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Faculty of Commerce, GLS UniversityReviewed on 20 Mar 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the teaching and placements but dissatisfied with the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities members were quite average at this college. Classrooms and all were quite decent, but they were huge and big. Also, one classroom had a seating capacity of 100 students. In terms of sports, this college provided many sports to play, like cricket, badminton, and football, as it had a really big ground.

reviews.review_heading: GLS University is good.
reviews.review_text: The central library boasts an extensive collection of textbooks, reference materials, e-books, journals, and online subscriptions. They provide a rich repository of knowledge for academic and research purposes. Separate accommodations for male and female students are provided, featuring well-ventilated rooms equipped with essential amenities.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and campus life, decent placements, scope for improvement.
reviews.review_text: GLS University offers modern classrooms, Wi Fi well-equipped labs a large library and hostel facilities with security. The mess provides hygienic food. Medical support a gym and sports facilities are available. The campus ensures a great learning environment.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Faculty of Commerce, GLS UniversityReviewed on 8 Mar 2025)
reviews.review_heading: The best college, with great professors.
reviews.review_text: There are a lot of facilities available for the students on campus, like classrooms with projectors and TVs for students, Wi-Fi, and a library where almost every book important for our courses is available. The main facility offered by our course is the timing of classes, which is from 7:30 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. There are all facilities available in the hostel which are required by all students. The quality of food available in the mess is also quite good, and medical facilities are also available.

reviews.review_heading: Experience of BCA in GLS University.
reviews.review_text: The college doesn't have a proper hostel but they collaborated with many PGs around. The current collaboration is with hostels. It is pretty good. They host many socializing events. The food is amazing and top-notch quality. They also offer a shuttle service from PG to college and vice versa.

reviews.review_heading: Best college in Ahmedabad for the law after NLUs.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college is decent but they are improving it as a new building is under construction. College doesn't provide hostel facilities but they do have tie-ups with some hostels outside. At the moment, there is no ground and construction is going on. But there will be one after this construction process ends.

reviews.review_heading: Life-changing college for all students who want a good life.
reviews.review_text: In GLS, facilities and infrastructure are very good and awesome. Every student is satisfied with the college, teachers, and infrastructure. The teachers are humble and they give good responses. These consist of written papers that test the depth of knowledge in theoretical subjects. The quality of the food is good. Medical facilities and sports are at a satisfactory level.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Lovely Professional University.

content.Placements: The placement ratio of our college is very good and the packages vary from 5 to 25 lacs. There is also a very good opportunity for internship and I have taken a B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering, which is one of the best degrees at the college and provides many opportunities for placement in jobs.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel of our university is very good and it is well equipped with Wi-Fi. In our campus theories, there is also central library, which is very big and there is a lot of book and sitting space in which you can do your self-study. There are also many mess rooms and canteens in our university in which you can enjoy your food. There is also a hospital and here is an Olympic-size swimming pool and many playgrounds for sports activities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is not a good college for the electrical branch.

content.Placements: The placements are not up to par, and the companies that come here are mainly for the CSE or hotel management branch, judging by the package. The difference between CGPA and package is quite high. I mean, for a 9+ CGPA, you would be sitting for a maximum of 12 LPA, and no internship is provided.
content.Infrastructure: It is good but overpriced, and if one is taking a hostel - take BH5 or BH6 for boys, and for girls, BH5 or BH6 would be better as it is close to classes. The sports facilities are quite good because they have dedicated facilities for each sport. Medical facilities are enough to keep you alive.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Review of Lovely Professional University, Admission Office.

content.Placements: Placement is average if we compare it to the number of students in B.Tech CSE. But the genuine student who works hard will definitely get excellent placement. Also, CGPA matters when sitting on the placement grounds. The college also provides internships from the second year .
content.Infrastructure: Very strong Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The infrastructure is just wow. One of the largest libraries that can be accessed throughout mid-night for hosts. The canteen and medical facilities are excellent. Air-conditioned rooms and a large auditorium are also there.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college has good Infrastructure and facilities to upgrade our skills.

content.Placements: The maximum number of students who sit for placement will be placed at this university. The placement percentage will be around 70 to 80 percent. The highest package in CSE is 64 Lacs from Google, the average is around 6 to 8 Lacs, and the lowest will be 4 Lacs. Every MNC's will be coming to university for placement. Internships start in the 3rd year and around 40 to 50 percent of students get them.
content.Infrastructure: Coming to the infrastructure, the university has everything like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms with AC and the main thing, the library, which is on 5 floors and can accommodate 5000 students at a time, including a Mac lab. The hostel has 24/7 medical facilities, an on-campus hospital, Wi-Fi, and separate ground facilities for every sport. Many Olympic players are from LPU.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: The infrastructure is really good, as well as the faculty!

content.Placements: Our college placements are really good, with the highest placement ranging between 54-58 LPA. More than 1000 recruiters hire for various positions. The lowest package in the college is 4 LPA. Internships are also provided in the 3rd year with a starting stipend of 8000 rupees.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the campus is excellent, and the campus is very vast. In our departments, we have computer labs, AC smart classes, Wi-Fi, libraries, etc. Every type of sports and coaching facility is available. The hostels are well-maintained and secured for both girls and boys.

paragraphs: Lovely Professional University course admissions 2026 for all of its courses is either done through LPU (Admission Office)NEST or via other entrance exams. Check below the complete LPU (Admission Office) admission process:
Step 1: LPU (Admission Office) Application Process 2026

The mode of application is online at LPU (Admission Office). Candidates have to register for LPU ADMIT with basic details. The application fee for LPUNEST (soft copy of LPUNEST KIT) is INR 1,000 for boys and girls. The printed LPUNEST Kit is INR 1,500 for boys and girls.
Step 2: Slot Booking
Candidates need to book the slot to appear in the LPUNEST exam. Applicants can also download the admit card from the LPU portal.
Step 3: Appear for LPUNEST
Aspirants have to appear for LPUNEST after booking a slot. Depending on the course, LPUNEST will have any one of the following purpose:

LPU (Admission Office) also considers national-level entrance exams like CAT, MAT, CLAT, etc. to provide admission to specific courses. For some of the LPU programmes, the university calls students for personal interview round.
Step 4: Result, Counselling & Seat Allotment

After result announcement, aspirants need to choose the programme for admission. Further, candidates need to participate in the counselling session for guidance on seat allotment and scholarship opportunities (if applicable). Seat allotment is done based on counselling and on a first-come-first-serve basis.
Step 5: Admission Confirmation

Aspirants need to further fill out the admission form and deposit an initial fee of INR 10,000. After successful payment, a unique provisional registration number is generated and sent to registered email id. One must also upload the specified documents and deposit the balance fee within the timeline specified by the university.

The university offers full-time PhD in Computer Science,Microbiology, Physics, Economics, Punjabi, etc. Part-time PhD programmes are available inPhysical Education,Tourism Management, etc. Candidates who have passed with a minimum of 55% aggregate or equivalent in master's degree (2 year or 4 semesters master's degree after a 3 years bachelor's degree) or equivalent in relevant subject can apply for the PhD programme. Aspirants need to pass MSc in relevant subjects with at least 65% aggregate to apply for PhD Entomology, Plant Pathology, Soil Science and Fruit Science. The selection for this course is based on LPUNEST (PhD) scores of the candidates followed by an interview round.

faqs.question: How can I get admission in PhD programme at LPU Admission Office?
faqs.answer: LPU Admission Office shortlists candidates for PhD admission based on their scores in LPUNEST. Aspirants who pass the entrance test have to further qualify interview round. The final selection for PhD admission is based on performance of the candidates in entrance test (80% weightage) and interview (20% weightage) subject to scoring minimum marks in the interview round.

faqs.question: Is LPU entrance exam hard?
faqs.answer: LPUNEST is a national-level exam conducted by LPU for admission to various courses. LPUNEST forms the basis of eligibility for some programmes and also for the scholarship programmes. The amount of scholarship is determined by the marks and rank obtained by candidates in the exam. LPUNEST exam pattern elucidates the scheme of the question paper. Candidates seeking admission through LPUNEST must check the exam pattern prior to starting the preparation. LPUNEST exam pattern imparts details like total number of question, subjects, marking scheme, exam duration, etc. The entrance test is neither hard nor easy. Candidates must prepare well to score the qualifying marks in the entrance exam.

faqs.question: Can I get admission at LPU Admission Office without entrance exam?
faqs.answer: LPU (Admission Office) offers admission to most of the programmes based on LPU NEST scores. The university conducts LPU NEST to select candidates for admission to UG and PG courses. Besides, the university also accepts other entrance exam scores for admission to MBA and BDes courses.

faqs.question: How can I get admission at LPU Admission Office?
faqs.answer: Lovely Professional University (Admission Office) offers admission to candidates based on their scores in entrance exam. The university conducts LPU NEST to shortlist candidates for UG and PG courses. Selected candidates have to participate in the counselling rounds to get a seat in the university.

placement_data.title: Lovely Professional University, Admission Office Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: This year, LPU has offered the highest package of INR 2.5 crore per annum and the second highest package of INR 1.03 crore per annum. reviews.review_heading: Review of Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: The hostel of our university is very good and it is well equipped with Wi-Fi. In our campus theories, there is also central library, which is very big and there is a lot of book and sitting space in which you can do your self-study. There are also many mess rooms and canteens in our university in which you can enjoy your food. There is also a hospital and here is an Olympic-size swimming pool and many playgrounds for sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: It is not a good college for the electrical branch.
reviews.review_text: It is good but overpriced, and if one is taking a hostel - take BH5 or BH6 for boys, and for girls, BH5 or BH6 would be better as it is close to classes. The sports facilities are quite good because they have dedicated facilities for each sport. Medical facilities are enough to keep you alive.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lovely Professional University, Admission Office.
reviews.review_text: Very strong Wi-Fi throughout the campus. The infrastructure is just wow. One of the largest libraries that can be accessed throughout mid-night for hosts. The canteen and medical facilities are excellent. Air-conditioned rooms and a large auditorium are also there.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good Infrastructure and facilities to upgrade our skills.
reviews.review_text: Coming to the infrastructure, the university has everything like labs, Wi-Fi, classrooms with AC and the main thing, the library, which is on 5 floors and can accommodate 5000 students at a time, including a Mac lab. The hostel has 24/7 medical facilities, an on-campus hospital, Wi-Fi, and separate ground facilities for every sport. Many Olympic players are from LPU.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is really good, as well as the faculty!
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is excellent, and the campus is very vast. In our departments, we have computer labs, AC smart classes, Wi-Fi, libraries, etc. Every type of sports and coaching facility is available. The hostels are well-maintained and secured for both girls and boys.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure but average faculty, placements are average.
reviews.review_text: Courses are planned well; at the beginning of the semester, they provide the details of the course that will be taught throughout the semester. Hostel rooms are good; all types of rooms, like AC and non-AC, are available as per the charges. The food quality provided in the hostel mess is average.

reviews.review_heading: Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: LPU is known for its well-equipped infrastructure. LPU boasts a well-furnished and air-conditioned room with modern teaching aids. LPU houses a digital library with a vast collection of e-books, journals, and other academic resources. LPU has innovation studios, which make the students come together and think creatively and innovate marvelous things out of it. If we talk about hostels, then LPU has high-capacity hostels, but only a few blocks are well maintained, and once you are in your 2nd yea...

reviews.review_heading: College is good for education.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the LPU is very good and it has been ranked A+. All the facilities are good and it has a very big library for students and faculty. It also has a university hospital so the medical facilities are good and 24/7 ambulance services are available.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi infrastructure is quite good. The classrooms are less equipped with smartboards and comfortable chairs. AC and fans are both available in classrooms. Proper ventilation is available in classrooms. Hostels are safer as compared to independent rooms. Overall, it was good.

reviews.review_heading: LPU’s actual review. It’s worth or not?
reviews.review_text: Internet services along with the facilities of the hostel and the mess are good. You will be provided with all the amenities. Medical facilities are also provided by the college. We have a hospital in the campus itself. We have different food courts in the campus and of reputed companies including Dominos. The entire campus is vegetarian.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty for a promising future.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure were nice and pleasant to see, with beautiful trees. The food quality available in the canteen, mess, and hostels were good. Available facilities included classrooms, libraries, labs, canteens, computer systems, Wi-Fi, transport, hostels, and well maintained playgrounds. Games and sports were regularly conducted for students.

reviews.review_heading: Cracking the Code: My Journey in LPU's B.Tech CSE.
reviews.review_text: The college provides a high speed Wi-Fi connectivity across the campus. Modern computer labs with the latest equipment are provided. There are an ell-equipped classrooms for interactive learning along with a library having an extensive collection of resources. The hostel rooms are comfortable and well-maintained with a satisfactory quality. The mess food offers a variety of nutritious options which is decent with focus on hygiene. On-campus medical assistance is available along with an access to...

reviews.review_heading: LPU- one of the best private Universities in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is quite good. We have more than 6 hostels for boys and around 8 hostels for girls. There are projectors and Wi-Fi networks in every class. The college has an indoor stadium, a cricket ground, a football ground, and also  malls inside the campus along with a hospital. Every year there is competition between the hostels in sports and extra curricular activities.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Lovely Professional University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the campus is very good. There are many facilities; there are laboratories and workshops with the latest equipment and Wi-Fi is available all over the campus with speeds of 40–50 Mbps. The quality of the food in the hostel is not good. There is no non-vegetarian food available on campus. Canteen food is also not hygienic. All types of sports are available on the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty, good placements in 2023, and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of our college are very good. Our college has Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. Everything is in very good condition. The quality of the hostel facilities is very good. And the food quality is also good. Medical facilities are also available.

faqs.answer: Students who are looking for admission at NSOU need to meet the last educational qualification.  Admission is through Management Entrance Test (NSOU-MET) followed by Personal Interview (PI) of 100marks. faqs.question: Is pursuing MBA at Netaji Subhas Open University expensive?
faqs.answer: No, compared to other universities, earning an MBA at Netaji Subhas Open University (NSOU) is not expensive. Offering a more cost-effective option for higher education, NSOU charges a total course fee of INR 1,00,000 (Rupees One Lakh). By contrast, the entire cost of tuition for the MBA/PGDM programme at Netaji Subhas University is INR 2.7 Lakh, signifying a much higher expense. Because NSOU's tuition is less expensive, it's a more affordable choice for people who want to study for an MBA without having to pay for too much. As a result, NSOU offers a reasonably priced way to earn a useful business administration degree, making it a desirable option for individuals wishing to continue their education without having to put a significant strain on their finances.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Netaji Subhash Open University.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is below average. The college doesn't have any campus; they have just a small house-type building. This is all they have; they don't provide hostel facilities because they don't have any hostel. There is no library and no good classrooms in the college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Acharya Prafulla Chandra Roy  Government CollegeReviewed on 5 Jun 2024)
reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Good quality equipments are available with up to date knowledge faculty members. The classes are equipped with projectors for smart classes. The classrooms are spacious and well lit. The environment is very cozy and quiet. The library has adequate amount of books and operates on a weekly basis. There is a gym room but it has not been opened yet for the students. The sports facilities are not very great as there is not any big playground is available.

reviews.review_heading: NSOU is excellent for us.
reviews.review_text: We have Wi-Fi facilities throughout the campus. The classrooms are well-lit and clean. All the benches are fine. It has a huge central library and some small libraries having a large collection of books. The food served in the canteen is very tasty and the food court has a wide range of food available. The University has proper medical facilities. Our college provides a large football field inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: NSOU is better than other government universities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is beautiful. The buildings are well maintained. All classrooms are well-lit. There is a free Wi-Fi facility throughout the campus. The library is huge and has a large collection of books. Labs are well maintained. The food served in the canteen and food court is very tasty. The university has all kinds of facilities for every student.

reviews.review_heading: Low-quality college for education.
reviews.review_text: There is no good infrastructure. Every facility is there. Wi-Fi is available but most of the time there is no internet. The campus is neat and clean but no AC is available. In the summer, it becomes very difficult to stay in the classes. Lifts are allowed only for staff. I am not happy about this.

reviews.review_heading: Good university for B.A. I am happy with my college.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good and so many trees are there. Sitting facilities are available to everyone. The library is available and if we want to take a book from the library, we need to show our college ID card. Good-quality canteens are available and a good-quality hostel is also available. Internet facilities are available here.

reviews.review_heading: The academic infrastructure is student-friendly.
reviews.review_text: University has Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs and classrooms, library, canteen, hostel, cafe. University has medical facilities for students. They have sports and game spot. Hostel has safe and secure. The quality of food is healthy and tasty which is not harmful.

reviews.review_heading: University infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: university has Wi-fi facilities, labs, well-equipped classrooms, library, auditorium, museum, canteen, hostel, cafe, etc. For students, they have medical facilities, sports and games. And their food quality is very good. The quality of hostel is secure and safe.

reviews.review_heading: Everything is excellent. Placement is mediocre.
reviews.review_text: The college's infrastructure is excellent. Wi-Fi speed is around 5–6 MBPS in the hostel. College classrooms are big and have AC in some selected classes. The hostel's food menu is very good. It includes pulao, chicken, chowmein, etc. The college arranges various events every year.

reviews.review_heading: NSOU is a good college for advanced diploma course.
reviews.review_text: I am a local president so I don't stay in the hostel. Also, my diploma course is for 1 year so I don't know too much about the hostel. But whenever I visit my college campus, it is neat and clean and the Wi-Fi facility is also good. On the college campus, you will be able to buy good food. Emergency facilities are available for us. Classrooms are good and color painting was recently completed by the college.

The mode of application is online. Eligible aspirants can apply for the course of their choice on the official website of the university.
Selection Rounds

The university selects candidates for most of the UG courses based on their merit in the last qualifying exam. For PG courses such as MBA, admission is based on CAT, MAT or SEE scores. For some of the programmes such as LLM, MCA, BPharm and M.Ed, the university may conduct an entrance exam.
Counselling

Once the selection rounds are completed, selected candidates are called for counselling and document verification. Selected candidates must confirm their seats by paying theCSJMU feeto avoid rejection.

paragraphs: CSJM University awards financial assistance to economically weak students through mean-based scholarships funded by the University’s distinguished alumni and philanthropic institutions. The scholarships offered to the wards with low annual parental income are 25-50 per cent of the annual fee depending upon the need of the students. Such candidates are required to provide an income certificate issued by the Tehsildar or the Magistrate.

In addition to this, Kanpur University also offers merit-based scholarships to students who have secured a minimum of 60 per cent aggregate or CPI of 6.5 out of 10 in the previous qualifying exam. The names of the students for scholarships are finalised by the University Committee that comprises every year.

review_summary.college_name: Bangalore University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Data Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Above average and decent college, value for money.

content.Placements: The placements are decent, but most of the roles are catered to Computer Science students, so there is a dent in placements for Data Science in particular. Top roles often offered being AI/ML engineers, software testers, etc., and if you are good with coding, then it will work for you.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is good, but a point to note is that the Wi-Fi does not always work and the network is often very slow in the campus buildings, otherwise, the campus, classrooms. Labs are good, and there are canteens around the campus.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college with good workflow and connectivity across the city.

content.Placements: I am studying BCA at Presidency College, which is a good college in Bangalore. 30 percent of students got placed last year in our course. The highest salary package offered is 10 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered is 4 LPA. Companies like Accenture, Flipkart, IBM, etc., hire students. The placement record of the college has significantly improved over years. There is a very good placement record among all the other colleges.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is not that great. It is a small college. The college does have Wi-Fi and hostel facilities. The college is doing well in sports and games in recent years and offers a variety of different games for every individual who has different interests in many things.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Management (BBM) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college has a good education system.

content.Placements: Placements are good. Many companies will come for a placement drive. Many have been selected in the placement drive and secured their first job in fields such as HRM, marketing, sales, and digital marketing. However, it ultimately depends on your skills, confidence, and the way you communicate.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are spacious. There’s proper ventilation, and hygiene is maintained in the washrooms too. We have a library, and it's very useful. Wi-Fi is only for the staff, not for students. There are science labs, an electronics lab, a mathematics lab, and a computer lab. There's also a canteen; overall, the infrastructure is good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Facilities are not good in our college.

content.Placements: No companies came for placement. Only a few came, and they were low-level companies. Guess what, college bought an agency for providing us placement for 2 LPA. Better to join somewhere else, at least those which provide placements.
content.Infrastructure: Don’t know about hostel, but friends are staying, and it is like a pure jail, no freedom. Also, the infrastructure as of now is very average. New buildings are not good. Currently, new buildings are constructed, but as of now, it’s very average.

individual_reviews.course: M.Tech. in Cyber Security - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of the Cyber Security department at UVCE.

content.Placements: About 95 percent of students got placed from our department last year. Top companies like TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, and Tech Mahindra come for recruitment. The highest package offered is 10 LPA, and the average package offered is 4.5 LPA. The university provides 100 percent internships in different companies.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure in our course are well-equipped. Wi-Fi is available in the class and labs. Wi-Fi is also available in the hostel, but with limited data. Labs and classrooms are well-equipped with AC. The hostel and mess food are adjustable. A paid canteen is also available. Medical facilities are available all the time.

individual_reviews.title: Xavier's consistency in producing quality students continues.

content.Placements: St. Xavier's is known for its placement cell. Top MNCs and Indian companies like EY, KPMG, BCG, Deloitte, DE Shaw, and ICICI offer jobs with good fresher salaries. The highest package offered is 24 LPA, and the lowest offered is 3 LPA. On average, a salary of 5-6 LPA is offered. Companies like Morgan Stanley, Zomato, Salesforce, and Hindustan Unilever also offer internships and later a PPO through the placement cell. Top roles offered are analyst, consultant, relationship manager, talent acquisition HR, marketing, and business development.
content.Infrastructure: College is well-equipped with 2 multi-media rooms, 2 libraries, a multi-cuisine canteen, 2 computer labs, a Fintech lab, and a basketball and volleyball court, along with 60 classrooms. The college also has very well-equipped and accessible washrooms for the physically challenged. There is an in-built campus hostel just for boys. Student Wi-Fi is available, but with very less connectivity. There is also a gymkhana for exercise, yoga, and indoor sports.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Data Science and Artificial Intelligence - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: A very good and vibrant college.

content.Placements: Since Data Science and AI come under the IT sector, jobs related to the course are similar to IT and CS, but more focused on analyst, data scientist, and AI/ML roles. The highest package here was up to 20–24 LPA, but as always, it depends on the students. Internships start from the 3rd year.
content.Infrastructure: They provide a boys’ hostel but not a girls’ hostel. There is a good canteen that has every type of food basically. AC classrooms and labs, a good library, and a playground are available. They give students a mail ID and Wi-Fi as well. They are strict with attendance. The college gives a good historic vibe.

reviews.review_heading: Xavier's consistency in producing quality students continues.
reviews.review_text: College is well-equipped with 2 multi-media rooms, 2 libraries, a multi-cuisine canteen, 2 computer labs, a Fintech lab, and a basketball and volleyball court, along with 60 classrooms. The college also has very well-equipped and accessible washrooms for the physically challenged. There is an in-built campus hostel just for boys. Student Wi-Fi is available, but with very less connectivity. There is also a gymkhana for exercise, yoga, and indoor sports.

reviews.review_heading: A very good and vibrant college.
reviews.review_text: They provide a boys’ hostel but not a girls’ hostel. There is a good canteen that has every type of food basically. AC classrooms and labs, a good library, and a playground are available. They give students a mail ID and Wi-Fi as well. They are strict with attendance. The college gives a good historic vibe.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good canteen. The woods are the best place to sit, and all Xavierites will agree with me.
reviews.review_text: Okay, not that great. Hostels are for boys only. It's okay, but they should have hostels for girls as well, as many students come from different states. It’s difficult to find a safe place to stay. It’s also hard for parents to send their child to a completely different place.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is amazing.
reviews.review_text: Excellent infrastructure and hostel if you compare with other colleges. Clean drinking water, electricity, and all the necessary amenities are provided. The building and hostel are all clean and nicely maintained, and the food is not bad, it's better than other places I have tried.

reviews.review_heading: Review of St. Xavier's College, Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: I chose botany for my M.Sc. because it's my favorite subject. The geology faculty members at this college are outstanding and have great knowledge. All professors are well-qualified, and their teaching methods are excellent. Term exams were conducted on time and were easy to pass due to thorough preparation. There is no hostel facility at the college as it is situated in a prime location in Jabalpur, where many coaching classes and affordable hotels and PG accommodations are available at economi...

reviews.review_heading: Vibrant college with a good return on investment.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are good, but since it is an old building. Some classes aren't well maintained. The library is amazing, with a vast array of books of all kinds. The canteen food is good, but a bit price. There is a boys hostel in the college. Students do get access to Wi-Fi, but it isn't available everywhere.

reviews.review_heading: Life at St. Xavier's College.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is old, and although it is beautiful because of its legacy and historical relevance, there is no air conditioning in most classrooms other than 2 or 3. The canteen food is very good, with great variety in all kinds of cuisines. Most hostel students rely on the canteen for all meals.

reviews.review_heading: Great campus life and networking with some amazing and inspiring people.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is great. It was built in 1900. It is still maintained well. There are labs for each department. However, the AC is available only in the lab, not in classrooms. Wi-Fi is there for both students and teachers separately. The library is huge and you can find rare books to research. The canteen in the college provides all types of cuisine at an economical price.

reviews.review_heading: St. Xavier's College Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well-designed and includes ramps and lifts for specially-abled people. It sometimes gets congested during break time. The hostel is available only for boys in odd years and not for girls. The area around the college is slightly expensive, with PG prices starting from Rs.14,000 for double sharing.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the money and the faculty, placements are nice if you're well-prepared.
reviews.review_text: Department facilities are quite good, where we have a Bloomberg terminal for further study. The hostel facility is average, and since it is inside the college campus is worth the money. The college tests are pretty effective in helping us prepare for interviews and will greatly benefit internships.

reviews.review_heading: The best college in Mumbai.
reviews.review_text: The facilities provided are a big library, with more than 10,000 books. Wi-Fi is available in the canteen and library. Classrooms and the quality of the facilities are good. The canteen food is amazing. The gymkhana includes badminton, table tennis, and carrom.

reviews.review_heading: The college has many events, so college life never feels dull.
reviews.review_text: The campus has a good canteen and two libraries: a lending library and a reference library. The libraries have a vast collection of books.  Sports facilities include basketball, volleyball, and hockey, among others. There is also an annual sports competition. The college has many clubs and societies, most of which are student-run. Applications for these clubs open every year. Some of the clubs include the Student Council, Social Service League, and World Performing Arts.

reviews.review_heading: The college has its merits and demerits.
reviews.review_text: There are no ACs, but the overall infrastructure is nice. The projector works fine. The Gymkhana is nice, and the sports in college are plentiful. The library has its own vibe; it feels like you are studying in Hogwarts, but the books are outdated in many aspects. The lending and reference libraries are two different libraries.

reviews.review_heading: Great place to find a good career if you’re willing to sacrifice college life.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms are top-notch with smart facilities, and the library contains tens of thousands of books where we can find almost anything that we look for. Although the Wi-Fi facilities offered were bad, and we rarely got network on campus. The mess and canteen are very good, offering food from all parts of India. The hostel is mediocre, and sports and games are not given importance; the college doesn’t even have a football court of its own.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, infrastructure, education, fests, etc.
reviews.review_text: There are facilities like libraries, laboratories, a canteen, boys' hostel, church, grounds, college hall, gymkhana, and classrooms available for students. The quality of food available in the canteen is very good. The non-teaching staff is kind and helpful here.

reviews_list.review_title: One of the top colleges in Bangalore, with top-notch infrastructure and faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Placements are really good, mainly because the college is located in a city like Bangalore. Compared to other colleges such as BMS and MSRIT, the placements are much better. They have a median package of 18 to 20 LPA for the AIML course, which is likely to increase in the future.
review_content.Infrastructure: The canteen and hostel facilities are really good. This might be the best thing about the university. The libraries are of top-notch quality. They have great basketball courts, badminton courts, and other sports facilities. The food available in the canteen is also amazing.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2030
reviews_list.review_title: I'm satisfied with the infrastructure, but it can include more extracurricular activities.

review_content.Placements: So 80-90% of students from my course got placed in top companies, and most of us managed to get jobs through campus placement. The highest salary package offered in our course is around 25 to 26 LPA. The average package is roughly around 11-13 LPA. Some of the top companies include KPMG, Deloitte, HDFC Bank, TCS, DELL, etc. Around 80-95% students got internships, and some companies offering internships are Wipro and Accenture. The roles offered through placement and internships are legal advisory, business development, legal research, and consulting.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Completely worth a one-time investment.

review_content.Placements: According to our seniors and the placement information given by them, around 85-90% of the people who were eligible for placements were offered internships/placements. The highest package was around 56-60 LPA last year, the lowest was maybe 3.2 LPA, and the average is 12 LPA. The whole MAANG came itself. Everybody who was eligible got an internship. Software Engineer/ SDE-2, Data Analyst, and Data Engineer roles are offered.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, but restricted to one device only, and the internet doesn't come on the campus. Classrooms and faculty are all world-class. I'm a day-scholar, but as per my peeps, hostel food is bad. But the canteen food is top-notch. Sports facilities are also top-notch. Gym (10K for RR campus and 6K for EC campus), both are good.

review_summary.college_name: PES University Bangalore Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: I am very satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: A total of 740 in the seniors' batch. Around 540 have been placed, and many have gone for higher studies. The highest package was 60 LPA. The median is around 12-13 LPA, and the lowest is not available. Companies like Zomato, IBM, Google, AWS, etc., come to this college. The top roles include SDE and ML engineer.
content.Infrastructure: Faculty have higher education with doctorate degrees, but the teaching is not very good. Most of the students self-study to score well. Infrastructure is 10/10. All the facilities are good, and everything you need will be available. As I am a day scholar, I don't know much about the hostel and mess.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: There are a lot of clubs technical and non technical which are worth.

content.Placements: In electronics and communication the placement was not that good compared to CSE till last year. The placements are decent for ECE but then in the last year there is a slight dip in the placements for CSE. The placement ratio is almost the same as before.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is nice and has a lot of extracurricular sports and a lot of eating spots. There are separate places for the hackathons to be conducted. There are a lot of auditoriums. There are separate blocks of each branch like B.Tech B.Com BBA etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: One of the top colleges in Bangalore, with top-notch infrastructure and faculty members.

content.Placements: Placements are really good, mainly because the college is located in a city like Bangalore. Compared to other colleges such as BMS and MSRIT, the placements are much better. They have a median package of 18 to 20 LPA for the AIML course, which is likely to increase in the future.
content.Infrastructure: The canteen and hostel facilities are really good. This might be the best thing about the university. The libraries are of top-notch quality. They have great basketball courts, badminton courts, and other sports facilities. The food available in the canteen is also amazing.

individual_reviews.course: B.B.A. LL.B. (Hons.) - Batch of 2030
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the infrastructure, but it can include more extracurricular activities.

content.Placements: So 80-90% of students from my course got placed in top companies, and most of us managed to get jobs through campus placement. The highest salary package offered in our course is around 25 to 26 LPA. The average package is roughly around 11-13 LPA. Some of the top companies include KPMG, Deloitte, HDFC Bank, TCS, DELL, etc. Around 80-95% students got internships, and some companies offering internships are Wipro and Accenture. The roles offered through placement and internships are legal advisory, business development, legal research, and consulting.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Completely worth a one-time investment.

content.Placements: According to our seniors and the placement information given by them, around 85-90% of the people who were eligible for placements were offered internships/placements. The highest package was around 56-60 LPA last year, the lowest was maybe 3.2 LPA, and the average is 12 LPA. The whole MAANG came itself. Everybody who was eligible got an internship. Software Engineer/ SDE-2, Data Analyst, and Data Engineer roles are offered.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good, but restricted to one device only, and the internet doesn't come on the campus. Classrooms and faculty are all world-class. I'm a day-scholar, but as per my peeps, hostel food is bad. But the canteen food is top-notch. Sports facilities are also top-notch. Gym (10K for RR campus and 6K for EC campus), both are good.

faqs.question: How can I get a seat in PES University?
faqs.answer: For getting seats in PES University, the student must satisfy eligibility criteria, give the PESSAT entrance exam, and then provide rank. Once students qualify for the entrance exam, they are short-listed on the basis of available seats and rank for counseling. Counseling will provide them with seats. So, proper application is to be followed and documents should reach the University in the time frame.

faqs.question: Is PES University admission open?
faqs.answer: Yes, admissions to the UG and PG programmes conducted at PES University are now open. All applicants have to fill their online application form at the university portal and enroll themselves for entrance tests such as PESSAT or any other entrance test valid throughout the country.

faqs.question: Can I join PES University after Class 12?
faqs.answer: If you qualify the eligibility criteria, then you can get admission to PES University after clearing class 12 and apply for the course you are interested in. faqs.question: Is PESSAT compulsory for PES University?
faqs.answer: Almost all courses in PES University can be admitted to if a student qualifies through PESSAT. It is the only entrance exam that the college looks into and includes for eligibility in their courses. However, in such exceptional cases like direct admission allowed for the high achievers, one may be exempted from the PESSAT process. Therefore, candidates have to clear the PESSAT exam with the prescribed minimum cutoff.

data: 100 Feet Ring Road, BSK III Stage, Bangalore (Main Campus)
Separate hostels for girls and boys
Library, Cafeteria, Hostel, Sports Complex, Auditorium, Research centres, Medical services, etc.

reviews.review_heading: I am very satisfied with the college.
reviews.review_text: Faculty have higher education with doctorate degrees, but the teaching is not very good. Most of the students self-study to score well. Infrastructure is 10/10. All the facilities are good, and everything you need will be available. As I am a day scholar, I don't know much about the hostel and mess.

reviews.review_heading: There are a lot of clubs technical and non technical which are worth.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is nice and has a lot of extracurricular sports and a lot of eating spots. There are separate places for the hackathons to be conducted. There are a lot of auditoriums. There are separate blocks of each branch like B.Tech B.Com BBA etc.

reviews.review_heading: One of the top colleges in Bangalore, with top-notch infrastructure and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The canteen and hostel facilities are really good. This might be the best thing about the university. The libraries are of top-notch quality. They have great basketball courts, badminton courts, and other sports facilities. The food available in the canteen is also amazing.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the infrastructure, but it can include more extracurricular activities.
reviews.review_text:
Facilities are quite excellent, including Wi-Fi for all and a specialised library for law. 
The quality of the hostel is also nice, but the food is not so much appreciated in the canteen, and it takes a lot of time to get prepared. 
There are quite a few sports games like football, basketball, badminton, etc. Including the top infrastructure courts for each sport.

reviews.review_heading: Completely worth a one-time investment.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is good, but restricted to one device only, and the internet doesn't come on the campus. Classrooms and faculty are all world-class. I'm a day-scholar, but as per my peeps, hostel food is bad. But the canteen food is top-notch. Sports facilities are also top-notch. Gym (10K for RR campus and 6K for EC campus), both are good.

reviews.review_heading: You will experience every feeling in this college, good placements, and good friends.
reviews.review_text: Our college offers a fine infrastructure with high-speed Wi-Fi and a well-built library to study with all kinds of books. A well-maintained canteen, well-facilitated sports field, and medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: PES: The real reason why to join PES.
reviews.review_text: The campus life, infrastructure, and both indoor and outdoor places are really well-maintained and well-equipped. This is one of the attractions at PES, where we get to see a huge block just for indoor sports and other co-scholastic activities. Here at PES, students get to play sports whenever they want, there are separate fields for different outdoor sports. One of the most attractive being is the cricket ground.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best private university, but the fee is too high.
reviews.review_text: For first-year students, the hostel is not on campus, but from the second year, the hostel is on campus. The Wi-Fi in both the college and the hostel is good. Facilities in the college are also good. The food is of good quality and quantity. Everything mentioned above is available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Worthy for course but not for money.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is quite good and aesthetically pleasing. To sit and study we have quite big libraries and Wi-Fi is available but sometimes it is a trouble to connect with them. Moreover, we have a boys hostel inside the college campus and a girl's hostel outside the campus which is contact based and it is taken up by a living space company, for girls hostel which includes food and snacks for the hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Totally satisfied with infrastructure and faculty, bit disappoint and concerned about placements.
reviews.review_text: Talking about infrastructure, our college has the best facilities. They provide us all we need, including a study area. We have four different libraries, including one exclusively for the law department, which has a collection of even rare books. There is also a three-storied central library and an international-level moot court hall. We have courts for basketball, volleyball, badminton, and tennis, with a highly structured gym facility for students. There are six canteens that provide clean foo...

reviews.review_heading: Good Placements, Great Exposure, but Super Difficult Exams.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is pretty much okayish, not so good I would say because I have seen my friends complaining about the hostel food and all, and also they are building a new hostel now. Wi-Fi, sports, and games are always there, but unfortunately, I am not in the hostel, so I don't know what exactly is happening there.

reviews.review_heading: Not what I expected it to be.
reviews.review_text: The college provided good classroom and lab facilities. The hostel rooms are decent compared to other hostels. There are four canteens on the campus, and the quality of the food is good. The campus is clean and huge. We have small stalls for snacks and stationery inside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: PES University at Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: PES University is a wide university including a lot of courses. Specialized lecturers are appointed for all the courses. A higher area is allocated for parking and sports courts. The library, with an extensive collection of books by various authors, was arranged in the college library.

reviews.review_heading: Slightly expensive for studies.
reviews.review_text: Students from different places come here to study, but there is no partiality or discrimination among them. The main aim of the college is to showcase the talents and skills of the students and help them succeed in their careers. But I'm not okay with the hostel food, so I would give it four stars.

reviews.review_heading: NammaPesu: An Honest Take.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good in our college. We have ample space for parking, playing cricket, football, and pretty much every outdoor sport. We also have 3 cafeterias, as well as a hospital upcoming in our campus itself. There is also a dedicated room for yoga, as well as a gym room.

The university also conducts student exchange programmes and faculty exchange programmes. The faculty at PES University Bangalore are diploma, PhD, and degree holders. The university also invites guest faculty for various lectures and events.

Given below are the three main steps in which theYCMOU admission processcan be completed:
Step 1: YCMOU Application Process 2025

For admission at YCMOU, candidates must fill out the application form through YCMOU’s official website by paying the required application fee for final submission. Candidates must keep prescribed documents with them while filling out the application form for a hassle-free application process.
Step 2: Selection Criteria

For admission to the majority of the programmes at YCMOU, candidates are selected based on their aggregate/ marks in the qualifying examinations, i.e. merit-based but for other courses like MBA, the university conducts its entrance exam. Candidates based on their performance in the entrance examination will be selected for further admission process.
Step 3: Final Seat Allotment

Candidates whose marks in the qualifying examination are under the specified range mentioned in the cutoff list or for courses like MBA for which YCMOU conducts entrance examination, candidates who perform well in the said examination will be selected for further admission process followed by document verification and fee payment leading to final seat allotment.

sports.description: To promote the holistic development of the students, YCMOU offers a variety of sports facilities to the students. The institute organises various regional and state-level competitive events under the Student Welfare Centre. The students who perform well in these events further represent the university in the INDRADHANUSHYA and ASHVMEDH competitions. A special financial provision has been made by the university for the sports events. This provision includes food, uniform and other expenses during practice sessions. The sports meet is held every year, which is organised by the eight Regional Centres of the University at the regional levels and students of the study centres in the jurisdiction of the respective region participate in these regional-level sports tournaments. After the tournaments are over, the students who excel at these tournaments participate in the sports meet organised by the University. Moreover, students who excel at the University level are sent to the All India Association of Universities tournament and the state-level Inter-University tournament ‘Ashwamedh’ every year.

2. Release of Cutoff List

After the application process, the institute releases a course-wise cutoff list. The cutoff list indicates the minimum required score in the respective entrance exam for a candidate to become eligible for admission. Candidates with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks can apply.
3. Counselling
Candidates applying for a BTech course further have to go through JAC counselling for seat allotment. While the candidates who apply for a PhD may have to go through an interview round.
4. Admission Confirmation
After the selection rounds and counselling, seats are allotted to the eligible candidates. Selected students can further pay the required fee to confirm their seats.

paragraphs: IIIT Delhi scholarships are provided under various criteria for the UG and PG level students. The scholarship amount or percentage differs according to the income of the parents.
Chairman’s Merit Scholarship for top BTech aspirants, admitted through JAC Counselling:

Any Delhi student with a JEE Main rank of less than 2,000, seeking admission at IIIT Delhi through JAC Counselling is entitled to a scholarship of Rs 1.25 LPA for four years, provided that the student maintains a CGPA of 8.5 or above. These students are not eligible for the income-linked fee waiver scheme of the scholarships.
Income-Linked Fee Waiver Scholarship:
Students pursuing any degree from IIIT Delhi are entitled to this scholarship based on following eligibility parameters:
Parents of the wards come under Below Poverty Line (BPL) category
The gross income of parents in service is up to Rs 6 LPA and the last school fee paid is less than Rs 25,000 per year
The gross income of parents in service is between Rs 6 LPA-Rs 8 LPA and the last school fee paid is less than Rs 45,000 per year

admission_process.title: DY Patil University Pune Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: DY Patil University Pune admissionsare primarilyentrance-based. The university accepts national or state-level entrance exams such as NATA,MHT-CET, CMAT, MAH CET, etc. for admission to specific courses. The university also conductsDYPCETfor admission to some of the courses such asBBA, MBA, etc. DYPU Pune offers a wide range of UG, PG, and doctoral programmes to students acrossEngineering, Management, and Science, among others.DY Patil Puneoffers courses through seven schools. Interested candidates can apply online on the official website of the university.

DY Patil University Pune is currently accepting applications for all courses. All the programmes are offered in full-time mode at UG, PG and doctoral levels. Below are keyDY Patil Pune admissionhighlights:
