Check otherDYPU Pune Courses

All the candidates seeking admission to DYPU, need to appear in an entrance test to secure a seat in their desired course. The seat intake varies depending on the programme. Programmes such as BArch have a very limited intake while a large number of students can be admitted to the BTech programme at DY Patil University. The table below shows the number of seats available for some of the courses at DY Patil University:
Note: Candidates must note that this information is sourced from the official website of the institute/university-sanctioning body and is subject to change.

The university offers admission both on an entrance and merit basis. Candidates have to get through all the selection rounds of the respective course to get a seat. The admission process involves application form filling and a selection process followed by counselling or an interview (for some courses). Below is the step-wiseDY Patil University Pune admission process:
STEP 1: DY Patil Pune Application Process 2025

The DY Patil Pune application process is carried out in online mode. Thus, aspirants can apply by visiting the official website of the university. The application process involves online registration, form filling, document upload, and fee payment. Candidates need to pay an application fee ofINR 800for UG and diploma courses. The application fee for PG programmes isINR 1,000.
STEP 2: Selection Process

DY Patil Pune accepts entrance exam scores for admission to most of the courses. The university accepts MHT CET, JEE Main, UCEED, NEET, etc. for admission to specific programmes. For UG, the candidates also need to qualify for Class 12. For PG courses, graduation in the relevant discipline is required. Candidates with the minimum qualifications will be eligible for admission. For the MBA, the university also calls candidates for the Written Ability Test and PI round.
STEP 3: Fee Payment & Admission Confirmation

The university releases a course-wise merit list on the official website of DY Patil Pune. Candidates who make it to the final selection list or are selected after counselling can pay the required amount of fee to confirm their seat. Also, the selected candidates have to submit specified documents for verification.

hostel.description:
D Y Patil University is residential campus. Accommodation is made available in three separate building in the campus for boys and girls, and has 1000+ capacity. For the food, campus has Legend Café managed by professional agency to cater the vegetarian and non-vegetarian food.  Hostel accommodation is allotted to students on First Cum First Service basis during the first year. The occupancy is single bed /double bed and triple bed and allotted to the students as per the availability.
It has the best accommodation facilities for boys and girl students. Campus provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities, catering to diverse needs and interests. Students have the flexibility to choose between twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, each furnished with unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi and regular housekeeping services. For the safety of students is a top priority, with full-time wardens, CCTV monitoring, and biometric entry enabled at security gate.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent and beautiful campus, with the best facilities. Placement needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs specific to the course, such as regular lab upgrades are done based on industry needs. There are ML, IoT, Robotics, and Embedded Systems labs, with high-performance systems and licensed software.  The college hostel rooms are good, and it is a beautiful campus.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is awesome, and the faculty is good, but the only thing is that placement is not good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best. Entire campus  have Wi-Fi networks, and labs are the best. Classrooms are also the best, and the library is average. The hostel is the best, but it is very costly. The quality of food available in the mess is good, and medical facilities are average. In sports, the university has a separate academy. The university's cricket ground hosts leagues like the Vijay Trophy, DY Patil Trophy, etc.

reviews.review_heading: The college is nicely maintained, but it can also be more upgraded in various fields.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure provided to students is quite good. Our college has multiple labs set up for students to study, which helps them grow their skills and gain experience in their particular domain. The hostel facilities are also available for students, located near the college only.

reviews.review_heading: The campus is so peaceful.
reviews.review_text: The college has facilities like Wi-Fi, a good ambience, and tables according to our department, which are comfortable, so we can work properly. The hostel has Wi-Fi and a mess facility. The food in our mess is good. We do have other food items.

reviews.review_heading: I love the campus, and it has the greenery.
reviews.review_text: The college is nice. We have a library, computer lab, and a workshop for working on models. The classrooms are well infrastructure, and the tables are according to the work, so they are comfortable. Both the hostel and the college have Wi-Fi. The food is good.

reviews.review_heading: Worth the Money and Average Placements.
reviews.review_text: Now, this is the good part, the hostel is good, and the mess facilities are decent at best. The workshop has all the basic equipment, but items used, like wood and thermocol, have to be supplied by students themselves, along with the additional cost and travel and arranging transport to bring them to the college workshop.

reviews.review_heading: A single floor college.
reviews.review_text: Food in canteen is decent, a bit pricey but okay. The hostel is strict and doesn't allow students to go out after 7:00 PM, forcing students to use canteen food for dinner that way. The area around the hostel is bad, crime rates are at the highest, and transport issues are there as it's in the middle of nowhere.

reviews.review_heading: Review for D. Y Patil University, Ambi, Pune.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi services are available full-time, and electricity backup is also there along with an abundant water supply. The hostel has three types of rooms single, double, and triple. Water coolers are placed on every floor in each building. Washing machines are available in hostels. There are two types of hostels old and new.

reviews.review_heading: If you have no option left and you think that you can study on your own. But, just need a degree.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, there's no doubt they have massive buildings. There are a total of 5 buildings, and all are above 7 floors. Classrooms are pretty huge, and they have a professional cricket ground. However, they lack auditoriums. The one we have is super small.

reviews.review_heading: I am not so satisfied with faculty members, and placements are not there.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and campus are pretty good and well-maintained. Wi-Fi facility is available, and there is a library and canteen are available. The infrastructure for the course is decent, not good, but there are huge spacious classrooms with proper ventilation and sunlight. However, desks are not good, and the seating is not proper. There is no proper management, no computer labs, and no proper facilities. However, the college has a cricket stadium, which is one of the biggest.

reviews.review_heading: Dr. D. Y. Patil College, Pune - Good campus and teachers, strong industry tries.
reviews.review_text: I like the atmosphere of our college because of the greenery and refreshing air with multiple buildings and spacious too. Lack of faculty members according to the fees we pay for our college. Management is not good and should take initiatives properly and responsibly. I hope they take our feedback properly also and are properly maintained. We take a lot of effort to complete it with sleepless nights. But still, our assignments are not given that much value for the efforts we have made, thank you...

reviews.review_heading: A transformative college experience with strong academic and professional campus life.
reviews.review_text: Departments are offered well-equipped design studio, CAD labs, model making workshop, high-speed Wi-Fi, good library, and smart classroom. The library is stocked with design journals, books, and resources. Hostel facilities are clean, secure, and comfortable offering a peaceful environment for students. The mess provides hygienic food with decent variety. The canteen provides additional snacks. Medical facilities are provided on campus. Sports facilities are provided for both indoor and outdoor ...

reviews.review_heading: A transformative college experience with strong academics and vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi facilities are provided. Hostel is well maintained, but has a few restrictions. Canteen food is pretty good. Sports and games I am not really interested.

reviews.review_heading: Recommendations for a good architecture college.
reviews.review_text: New hostel block is completely good with all sorts of modern equipments. The cleaning and maintenance of the hostel is done well. There are options to choose from single, double, and triple sharing rooms. Wi-Fi and laundry facilities are also available at the hostel here.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and campus worth it.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities like well-equipped Wi-Fi, library, many sports events keep happening, with good cricket ground, basketball court, football, and volleyball also. It has good canteen services with hygienic food. Good toilets are there. The campus is always clean.

The canteen at DY Patil University is spacious with modern furniture and provides traditional food of various tastes from various states of India at a reasonable price. placement_data.title: Mount Carmel College Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: The placement statistics for the Class of 2025 are yet to be released on the official website. The Mount Carmel College has achieved 79% UG and 49% PG placements in the academic year 2023-24. A total of 723 UG students registered for placements, of which 572 secured job offers with decent packages. The highest and average salary secured by UG batch 2024 was INR 14 LPA and INR 4.33 LPA. The top recruiters of Mount Carmel College who participated during the recent drives include JLL, EY, Deloitte, Godrej, JPMG, TCS, Cisco, etc.

faqs.question: How much placements salary students get after studying in Mount Carmel College?
faqs.answer: Mount Carmel College offers median package range of (aprx)INR 360,765 during in-campus placements. It has a decent placement assistance program as well. Additionally, it has been rated 3.8 on placements as per Shiksha verified reviews by students.

faqs.question: How is the placement facility at Mount Carmel College?
faqs.answer: Thew placement facility at Mount Carmel College is good. The college also has a placement cell that helps students get good job offers from top companies. As per Shiksha verified reviews, Mount Carmel College has an impressive review rating of 3.7 by 143 students.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for B.Com at Mount Carmel College? How is the placement for this course at this college?
faqs.answer: For taking admission in Mount Carmel College in B.Com stream, students must have completed 2 year pre university examination (PUC) of Karnataka state or equivalent examination along with the good scores obtained by candidates in the CBSE 12th. According to the placement reports, the average package offered in the course is INR 2-3 LPA and the highest salary package is INR 7-10 lpa. Internships and industry projects are offered every year. Roles offered for B.Com graduates are Accounting Executive, Financial Analyst, Tax Consultant, Audit Associate, Investment Banker and Marketing Executive. These roles given are of Finance, Accounting, Marketing and Consulting Sectors. There is organised and active placement process with the involvement of employment cell. About 80% to 90% B.Com students secure placements.

faqs.question: What is the highest package offered at Mount Carmel College placements?
faqs.answer: Mount Carmel College seems to have a good placement record. The highest package that Mount Carmel College gives is around INR 7.5 Lacs per annum. Well-reputed companies: Wipro, TCS, Accenture and Amazon would visit the campuses for recruitment. About 80% of students end up getting placed or secured internships through these opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it is the best college for the M.Sc. in Life Sciences course.
reviews.review_text: The college provided Wi-Fi in the hostels, but we had to fill out a form and ensure availability to get access. Classrooms were fully air-conditioned, but the hostels were not. Every hostel had a special menu. The mess food was fine. There were also three restaurants on campus.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worth the money and satisfactory as it has good placement, especially for my course.
reviews.review_text: In my college, students get Wi-Fi and have a well-organised library where we can easily get books. Our college also has its own on-campus and off-campus hostel facilities. And they provide both non-veg and vegetarian food in the hostel, and the hostel costs approximately Rs. 1,80,000 per year.

reviews.review_heading: About MCC College BBA business analytics.
reviews.review_text: College itself is really small, and this year the crowd has way too much. Other than that, they have Wi-Fi for each classroom. There is a huge library and all courses have labs. Hostel is not good so most of them go for close by PGs which are much better option. Food in canteen is very good and has really nice veg and non-veg options. MCC sports team is good, especially basketball.

reviews.review_heading: Amount Carmel College – Denotes the major "CCC" (Competent, Confident and Compassionate)
reviews.review_text: Amount Carmel is rated as the 3rd top college in India and the 2nd best college in Bangalore. All facilities are available in the college. It provides the best Wi-Fi connection, all classrooms have smart boards, and the library is vast with all kinds of books. Hostel accommodation is available for all students, with good food service along with canteen food. Every year, the college hosts a khel sports meet and provides good medical and counseling services.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent campus and faculty support, but placement opportunities need improvement.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are available, like student Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library. I don't prefer to say anything about the hostel as I don't have any idea about it, but other than that, canteen, medical facilities, sports, and games are available, which are helpful for students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of crowd and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
Infrastructure of hostel is not good. 
No food, problems in the washrooms. 
Like, no hot water and no gym. 
There is a curfew of 7:30. 
Canteen food is good and reasonable.
There are not many sports facilities. 
The Wi-Fi of the hostel does not work at times.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with placement opportunities and training facilities provided.
reviews.review_text: The college has a good infrastructure. They provide us with Wi-Fi, a library, well-maintained classrooms and environment, an auditorium facility, a canteen, labs, etc. They provide us with quality food on the campus, water facilities are also available on every floor, and clean washrooms.

reviews.review_heading: Best college of Bangalore for sure.
reviews.review_text: We do have a great campus and spacious classrooms. These classrooms are equipped with the best technology, which makes it easier for us to study. We do have a college Wi-Fi as well. Our library is very well-equipped with various kinds of books and even journals. As I have not opted for the hostel, I won't be able to give any details regarding that. But I do know that the security and food facilities are good in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: A good campus.
reviews.review_text: We've all the facilities in our college, which gives good quality labs, open Wi-Fi for all the students, and talking about the canteen, the food is too yummy and affordable, cooked with hygiene and neatness, and opportunities to participate in various competitions also. The campus provides good security for students, and a water supply facility is provided on each floor of each block of the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning experience.

Quality of food at the canteen is not negotiated, but it is a little bit expensive. College have medical facilities and sports associations as well. College also held inter-college sports competitions.

reviews.review_heading: College provides good education, and the teachers are very friendly.
reviews.review_text: College is well-maintained and clean, with comfortable classrooms, a canteen, labs, an auditorium, sports grounds, and more. The campus covers 10 acres and includes a parking area for teachers. The washrooms are cleaned daily to maintain cleanliness throughout the campus.

The food had to be catered for. This was for a single room which was just about s...

reviews.review_heading: It is the best university to grab an education.
reviews.review_text: The college has very high-speed Wi-Fi connectivity, which is accessible to all students. Classrooms are well-equipped with good infrastructure. The college has the best library facilities with a large collection of books resources, and journals for focused learning. The college provides full facilities for students.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Mount Carmel College.

paragraphs: MIT Academy of Engineering, Alandi admission 2025is a blend of merit and entrance basis. Students can pursue several undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral levels. These programmes are offered in various fields of Engineering and Design. Also known asMIT AOE Alandi, students need to satisfy the preset admission criteria of the desired programme to be eligible for admission into the institute. The courses offered at the institute are provided in affiliation with Savitribai Phule Pune University (SPPU). The admission and application process for the institute generally commences online. Interested students can read the following article to know all about the courses, eligibility, and other admission-related information for MIT Academy of Engineering, Alandi admission.

MIT Academy of Engineering Alandi course admissionto the UG, PG and PhD courses is based on course-specific entrance exams. MITAOE also offers lateral entry for second-year BTech programme Admission to MITAOE Alandi can be secured directly through CAP rounds or at institute level on merit basis and or during SPOT rounds. For PhD admissions, students must either provide valid score obtained in any of the accepted entrance tests, such as GATE/ SPPU-SET or appear for the institute-level test;MITAOE PET. MIT Academy of Engineering Alandi's admission processincludes several steps.These include- application, selection, counselling and fee payment. The entire application process is in online mode. Below is the step-wise admission process of MIT Academy of Engineering Alandi:
1: Application Process
The admission process begins with registration of the candidates online on the official website of MITAOE. Candidates must fill out the form and pay the application fee.
2: Selection Process

Once the registration is done, the candidates will be shortlisted based on the marks obtained in the entrance exams for the respective courses they chose. MITAOE takes in account both academic merit and entrance exam scores to make a merit list of the eligible candidates for each course.
3: Counselling and Fee Payment

Once the candidates are shortlisted, they will be contacted by the university for counselling. The shortlisted candidates will have to pay the course fee and submit the required documents to confirm their seat in the college.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MIT Academy of Engineering, MAEER.
reviews.review_text: The campus looks a bit old and small, but all the necessary facilities are available. The campus is divided into wings labeled A-F. All wings have their own Wi-Fi, toilets, and drinking water filters. There is one big library with air conditioning.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with teaching but infrastructure and campus are not satisfactory.
reviews.review_text: Some buildings have Wi-Fi but some don't. Classrooms are okay and labs are also okay. All practicals in the lab are done properly. Canteen is also good and food available is fresh and healthy. Sports and games are not that much. College hostel is too much costly. College library is also satisfied.

reviews.review_heading: MIT Academy of Engineering, MAEER is not worth.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available only in the college library and the Internet section. MIT Academy of Engineering has built a new hostel this year, but many students cannot afford college housing. The food quality in the college canteen is fairly good, but the canteen is very small; at one time, only 70 to 80 students can be seated. There are no medical facilities available on campus, and sports activities are not provided.

reviews.review_heading: MITAOE Alandi Campus, infrastructure, curriculum overall review.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available throughout the campus, and while the classrooms are decent overall, the desks need to be changed. MITAOE offers a well-developed infrastructure for engineering courses. The classrooms are spacious, well-lit, and equipped with projectors and whiteboards to support smart teaching methods. The college provides high-speed Wi-Fi in all academic blocks, which is particularly helpful for research and coding tasks. Each department has its dedicated laboratories with up-to-date equipme...

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with some of the faculty, as they have a good level of knowledge.
reviews.review_text: The college campus is not good because it has no grounds for playing, and the labs lack proper facilities. The laptops and PCs are not functioning properly, and the ventilation system is inadequate; it feels very hot inside the lab. In the hostel, there are many problems: Wi-Fi is not working properly, and the facilities are lacking.

reviews.review_heading: The academics are very good and the placement record is also good.
reviews.review_text: I'm staying at the MIT hostel only. The infrastructure is good, and the facilities are also decent. I think that the only problem is that it is located in Alandi, which is not well developed. Also, faculty members are decent, they help you in many aspects.

reviews.review_heading: Supportive environment with decent infrastructure, needs improvement in faculty engagement.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are equipped with projectors and Wi-Fi. Labs for computer engineering are well-maintained, with decent systems and internet. However, some hardware is outdated and needs upgrades. The library is good with a wide range of technical books and a quiet study environment.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good but we have to work hard for placements.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not so good but they are developing it for good. Classrooms are good but in the summer, we may have some problems as classrooms do not have any AC and only fans are available. Labs do have ACs and the library does not charge any fees for cards. Wi-Fi is available in every building, There are 2 canteens on our campus. The food quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, the college is good. If students want a big campus, then this college is not for them.
reviews.review_text: The hostel fee is so much overpriced, so they do not even justify the faculty members they are providing. Labs are very old. MIT Academy of Engineering (MITAOE) in Alandi, Pune, is generally well-regarded, particularly for its strong placement record and focus on practical learning. The institute's location in Alandi, away from the city bustle, is seen as a plus for those seeking a peaceful environment.

reviews.review_heading: Experience of college life.
reviews.review_text: The institute provides spacious lecture halls equipped with comfortable seating and necessary teaching aids. Laboratories are well-furnished with essential equipment to facilitate practical learning. Wi-Fi connectivity is available in some classrooms and the hostel areas.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides excellent placement opportunities.

content.Placements: Our college regularly conducts placement workshops to prepare students for job interviews. This helped us to be industry-ready by the time we completed our course. Almost 90% of students got placed. The highest salary package offered was 18 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was available throughout the campus. Air-conditioners and projectors were available in classrooms. Stitching labs, textile labs, etc., were available. Classrooms were spacious and well-equipped. The hostel facilities were good.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: I did Post Graduation course, journey was amazing overall. I definitely recommend it.

content.Placements: Placements were just okay. Not all Post graduated students were placed by the university. Candidates had to look for jobs on their own. Also in the practical world, more priority is given to lift students instead of Pearl so ya getting a job is quite a difficult bit ya who so ever were placed got a decent package as a fresher.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure wise nothing can beat Pearl Academy, Jaipur. The college provides Wi-Fi, classrooms, a library where you can log in to fashion websites free of cost, and access to stitching, dyeing, etc. Labs at any time of the day or call it any day. Nothing can beat the quality of services they provide.

individual_reviews.course: M.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent platform for fashion students to enrich their knowledge.

content.Placements: Our college provides 100% placements opportunities for students of various streams with possibilities where our career could get ahead. Top designers, graphic designers and marketing where they set us to be in top recruiters. They lead us to cover the mainstream.
content.Infrastructure: Our Jaipur campus has the best infrastructure for the designing students among India, with completely equipped machines. Opportunities have been completely given to us to enrich the knowledge of fashion throughout the course and trained us throughout.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Fashion Design - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Life changing opportunities with international exposure and excellent faculty members.

content.Placements: There is 99% placement by the college and depends on the portfolio. The highest salary goes to 5 lacs to 25k. Export Houses, Designers like Manish Malhotra, Yashraj Groups etc. recruited the students. All roles played by a designer from illustrator to tailoring to management to innovators was offered. Salary pachage to our course goes from 40 lacs to even 5 lacs. 100% students get internships as it depends on the portfolios and Pearl makes us capable enough to have an innovative and creative portfolio.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is to the point in case of facilities. The Hostels are really good and the mess too as my friends stay there and are very satisfied with the Hostel. There is time to time upgradation in the facilities demanded by the students. There is full freedom of speech and the facilities provided are very satisfying and useful for the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Des. in Interior Architecture Design - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, inspiring faculty, but can work better for placements.

content.Placements: The placements are still not so good. Seniors face difficulty in iad batch to find jobs. Some good students might get a good placement, but there is no 100 percent guarantee of placements. Although, it is improving now. We can find jobs abroad, but there are less opportunities in India.
content.Infrastructure: A medical room is, and good air-conditioning is available in the college. Labs and classrooms are neat and clean with proper air conditioners and projector screens. The Wi-Fi connection quality is not that good. Gaming and sports are good as there is a big playground on the campus.

individual_reviews.title: It is an affordable government college with good faculty and average placements.

content.Placements: The placement percentage is minimal, and I think only about 5 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is very rare in the rarest cases. No companies visit the college. Mostly, local institutes, coaching centers, small firms, or NGOs visit the college. Internships are self-arranged by colleges and are mostly not beneficial, so students should prefer finding internships themselves. In short, I will say that placements are not good. Here I have seen that most students, even my classmates, prepare for government exams or improve their skills by doing computer courses or other skill-based courses.

paragraphs: Graphic Era University admissionsare open for all courses. Candidates can appear for GECET or provide a score in accepted entrance exam for admission. Check below the steps to get a seat in the university:
1: Graphic EraApplication Process 2026

The Graphic Era University admission process starts with filling the application process in online or offline mode for the respective courses. Candidates who are interested in getting admission to any of the UG & PG courses can apply on the university's official website. The application fees is INR 1,500 for a course.
2: Selection Rounds

The selection to most of the UG & PG courses at the Graphic Era University is merit-based. Candidates are selected based on their merit scores obtained in the last qualifying exam. Aspirants can also get admission based on their national or university-level entrance exam scores in MBA and MDes programmes. The university also conducts an in-house entrance-cum-scholarship test -GECETfor UG and PG courses. Selected candidates also need to come for a personal interview round for admission to some courses such as MBA, MDes, etc.
3: Admission Confirmation

The selected candidates will be notified about the selection via call, email, or post. To confirm admission, candidates must pay theGraphic Era University feesand submit the relevant documents within the stipulated deadline.

In 2025, Graphic Era University climbed 4 ranks to #48 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.

In the 'Management' category, the institute's ranks have ascended when compared with the previous year's ranking. reviews.review_heading: The college has amazing management. There are placement issues for BCA.
reviews.review_text: Graphic Era Deemed to be University has great facilities of labs and the library. Computers in the lab are in very good condition. There are many labs for practice and a huge library in different blocks. Classrooms are amazing. It provides a smart board in each class. The hostel is a little costly but gives amazing infrastructure and services. The food is pretty good. It has space for both indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with the university. It has a great environment and a great hospital.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is great. I love the information about the graphics its great infrastructure, health care, and living. The food is provided. It has many canteens which provide great taste. It has all the departments. There is a big ground, and it provides a lot of fun.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, it's a good college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is average as it only covers 35 acres. But it's quite large. It seems small as the college has a very large number of students, especially in B.Tech courses. The crowd is quite large. Playground is also below average as it's not that big.

reviews.review_heading: No doubt my college is much better than any other in terms of areas.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities that students got from the Graphic Era Deemed to be University are much better and match our expectations, as we expected them to be the same. The mess serves quite good quality of food.

reviews.review_heading: This college is for those students who are more active in events and fests.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. The librarian and the library are also very large. Wi-Fi facilities are also available in the library. Classrooms could be more furnished, but they are good. The mess and canteen are also decent. There are medical facilities. Hostels are a little bit expensive.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty, infrastructure, etc, but not satisfied with placement opportunities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is very good. Classes are amazing, and every class has a smart board installed in it. There are many labs inside the campus, which provide better exposure to the practical aspects of the course. There are also many libraries available. The hostel is good, the food is also good and hygienic, and the hostels are disciplined and have high security.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely a good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: If I tell you about facilities, it’s average in my department. I’m not telling about other departments. Quality of hostel I don’t know. Quality of food is good. There are 4-5 canteens where food is available. All things were available and good, like sports, games, and medical facilities too.

reviews.review_heading: Graphic Era University review.
reviews.review_text: Every required facility is available, good food and infrastructure of hostels. We enjoy the services provided in our hostel, and along with that, we have great transportation facilities supported by the hostel and the college. It is a great place to get exposure.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive review of my B.Tech ECE program.
reviews.review_text: GU central library reportedly holds over 1,74,700 technical books, many periodicals, and journals. It also has a digital library with more than 1,200 general reading rooms with 300-seat capacity, a book bank, and reference or leading facilities. The campus is described as fully Wi-Fi enabled, as wired and wireless internet access is reported to be available 24x7.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent, really good college.
reviews.review_text: Excellent, Graphic Era infrastructure, of course. The hostel was so excellent, and our course and department were so good. Labs, classrooms, library, canteen, medical facilities, sports and games, etc., are all very excellent. Also, the mess of every hostel is so good, and the college provides us with Wi-Fi.

reviews.review_heading: Average college life at Graphic Era Deemed to be University. The crowd is lazy and distracted.
reviews.review_text: Most classrooms are outdated, like they were built 10-20 years ago. Wi-Fi is poor. First-year labs are bad. The library is cramped up in the break, and it's difficult to study as there are no power ports available. The quality of hostels is average, and so is the food. Medical facilities are average. Sports events and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: Comprehensive and industry-oriented B.Tech aerospace at GEU.
reviews.review_text: Over 90% of students got placed. The average package is 5.38 LPA, the median package is 7.25 LPA, and the highest is 54.80 LPA. Top recruiting companies are ISRO, Indian Air Force, Tata Advanced Systems, Airbus, DRDO, MRO, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied but could do better.
reviews.review_text: Labs, classrooms, and library are very good with comfortable seats and good equipment. Wi-Fi is average. For sports, the teams are good. Mess food is average, and canteens are great. Clinic is good for quick check-ups. Hostel facilities are good as they provide necessary things.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are very good. The quality of hostel is good for the students, and the quality of food is also good. They provide different menu everyday for the students. The facilities for sports and medical in my thinking this college is the best.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements, infrastructure, but average faculty.
reviews.review_text: I don't live in the hostel but the infrastructure is good. I have heard from friends the hostels are decent with all time Wi-Fi and water coolers running 24 hours. The classrooms are more than good. The hostel is good, the mess food is decent, the canteen has variety, plus we have medical help, and sports and games facilities.

After that, MBA colleges which accept CMAT score for shortlisting students start the selection process. There are about 1,300 MBA colleges in India which accept CMAT score for admission. All these colleges conduct admissions individually which includes, shortlisting of students on the basis of CMAT score, conduct of group discussion, written ability test and Personal Interview and final selection based on certain parameters.
